Type definitions for DFU initiator.

Typedefs

typedef uint16_t (*pf_dfu_init_cb_t)(uint8_t type, void *pdata)

Prototype for callback function used with DFU initiator operations.

Enums

enum dfu_init_phase_t

DFU initiation phase enumeration.

Values:

enumerator DFU_INIT_PHASE_IDLE

Initiator is in idle state.

enumerator DFU_INIT_PHASE_UPLOAD_START

Initiator upload process has started.

enumerator DFU_INIT_PHASE_BLOB_TRANSFER

Initiator is performing blob transfer.

enumerator DFU_INIT_PHASE_FAILED

Upload process has failed.

enum dfu_init_cb_type_t

Callback types for DFU initiator operations.

Values:

enumerator DFU_INIT_CB_TYPE_UPLOAD_PROGRESS

Callback for upload progress updates.

enumerator DFU_INIT_CB_TYPE_UPLOAD_SUCCESS

Callback for successful upload.

enumerator DFU_INIT_CB_TYPE_UPLOAD_FAIL

Callback for failed upload attempt.
